# Hedwig

> Hedwig checks a payment agent's pay or swap request against its owner's policy before the agent signs. It runs on the owner's computer, never holds a key, and never signs.

## Pages

- [Home](https://usehedwig.xyz/)
- [About](https://usehedwig.xyz/about)

- [Roadmap](https://usehedwig.xyz/roadmap)
- [Team](https://usehedwig.xyz/team)

- [For agents](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents)

## For AI assistants

- [Consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents.md): how to install Hedwig with your owner's approval and consult it before you sign a payment for them.
- [When to consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agentskill.md): which payments go through Hedwig first, and how to offer it when it isn't installed.
